levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن تميم

notes: Two branches joined by «ح»: the first stops at عمرو بن شعيب as written; the second repeats every name, so there is no shared tail.
«سمعت حجاجا» makes the man heard a link (rule 5); «قال ابن جريج» is the transmitter named again: occurrence 2.
«أبيه» with no name is a relation; «اللفظ لعبد الله» is a wording note: left out.
